beyond: The record fixes specific mechanisms that the owner's visible words do not state: links are left out of a record's hash; a requirement that gained an owning end is treated as an 'extension' and shown as '(extended)'; the merge 'exits 4' until re-approval; and a trace.exempt glob is 'not honoured until the owner confirms it' via 'plumb approve --exempt' or 'plumb relay --exempt'. The owner's words only ask for content hashes and staleness to be kept (and cite INT-006's 'a change on either end makes the link stale'). The exit code, the exemption mechanism and the link-excluded-from-hash design are added commitments. The INT-006 text is truncated in the record, so some of this may appear in its full wording, which I cannot see.
